detections.evidence_quote: the crew brought in their reverend. He joined in, and after six days, Walter died of dehydration.

detections.summary: Story of an eight-year-old autistic boy whose parents were recruited to a strip-mall church promising to heal his autism through a group healing.

detections.evidence_quote: an eight-year-old autistic boy named Terrence Cotrell died during church when members of his congregation attempted to all heal him at the same time.
detections.summary: Terrence Cotrell died during church as congregation members tried to heal him.

detections.evidence_quote: Tragically, though, exorcism is not just something performed on adults.
detections.summary: The faith-healing case concerns a young autistic child rather than adults.

detections.summary: Hosts explain the church's idea of physically forcing an evil spirit out of the body, linking it to laying on of hands.

detections.evidence_quote: when an evil spirit comes out of a man, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
detections.summary: The church framed the boy's condition as an evil spirit to be driven out, citing a biblical passage.

verification_candidates.claim_text: A church's faith-healing practice can heal a child's autism.
